title: A.D. White — Cross Creek records and the Whiskey Rebellion
subtitle: Bethel Presbyterian Church, Historical Room — oral history
date_source: A copyist's slate at the head of Side A: "recorded on July the 15th, a Thursday evening, 1971, at Hickory, Pennsylvania". 15 July 1971 was a Thursday. Side B carries no date of its own and is dated from that slate.

provenance.collection: Bethel Presbyterian Church — Historical Room oral histories
provenance.capture_notes: Two cassette sides, captured as ALAC 48 kHz stereo 16-bit. Side B's capture runs 1 h 35 m 22 s but only 20 m 15 s is programme; the dead tail was cropped for transcription and listening, and the untouched capture is kept as received.

speakers.label: WHITE
speakers.name: Alvin Dinsmore White
speakers.note: Of Hickory, Pennsylvania; author of the Cross Creek church history, and the lecturer in this series on 31 October 1971.

speakers.label: INTERVIEWER
speakers.name: Ann Connor and John Connor
speakers.note: The tape does not identify which of the two asks each question, so the label is shared rather than guessed.

speakers.label: NARRATOR
speakers.name: unidentified copyist
speakers.note: The slate at the head of Side A only; not a voice in the room.

speakers.label: UNKNOWN
speakers.name: unidentified family voice
speakers.note: One line at the close of Side B, in the room, not separable.
